item: 2 APM Design Lab: 8 model types that drive the calculation
change: New pure engine APMDesignLab.models.ts with 8 types (FFS baseline; shared savings one-sided = MSSP BASIC A/B; two-sided = MSSP ENHANCED; episode/bundled = CMS TEAM Track 3; partial capitation = ACO REACH Professional; full capitation = ACO REACH Global PY2026; global budget = Maryland/AHEAD HGB with HSCRC QBR; hybrid = labelled illustrative). Each type sets settlement mechanism (none/flat/corridor/full retention), CMS discount, risk corridors, MSR (MSSP one-sided MSR computed from attributed lives via 425.604(b) sliding scale), ENHANCED loss rate 1-0.75*quality bounded 40-75%, caps, and quality mode (withhold/CQS/symmetric). Selector loads the type's defaults into the sliders; risk arrangement is fixed by the type (editable only for hybrid); waterfall shows discount and corridor steps; panel shows real program, payment flow, corridors and source. Removed dead-state behaviour. 9 node:test unit tests incl. 'changing the model type changes the projection'.
data_sources: 42 CFR 425.604(b) MSR table (83 FR 67816 image ER31DE18.023)
42 CFR 425.605(d) BASIC levels (40% sharing, 10% cap)
42 CFR 425.610 ENHANCED (75%, 20% cap, loss rate 40-75%, 15% loss cap)
CMS TEAM final rule / fact sheets (2% LEJR, 1.5% CABG discount; Track 3 20% stop-gain/loss; CQS up to 10%)

CMS ACO REACH PY2026 Model Update Quick Reference (first Global corridor 10%, withhold 5%); Milliman 'ACO REACH PY2026: what is changing'; Pearl Health 'Performance Year Discount' (3.5% Global discount, Professional corridors 50/35/15/5)
Maryland HSCRC QBR RY2026 final memo (+/-2%, cut point 41%)
note: Book names 8 types but not which; used the 8 in the promise-audit spec. ASSUMPTION disclosed in UI + code: PY2026 Global corridor bands above 10% taken as 10-35% @50%, 35-50% @25%, >50% @10% (CMS moved only the first boundary; Milliman worked example confirms 50% just above 10%). TEAM CQS scaled linearly on 0-100 score (CMS uses percentile) - simplification noted in code. Attribution/benchmark-method selectors in the same tab remain descriptive only (not in this item's scope). tsc + eslint pass; `npx tsx --test scripts/test-apm-models.test.ts` 9/9 pass.

item: 3 APM Shared Savings Calculator: 14 Vermont hospital presets
change: Added VERMONT_HOSPITAL_APM_PRESETS (14 hospitals) with a 'Vermont's 14 Hospitals - Medicare' picker labelled DERIVED; selecting one loads attributed lives + benchmark PMPM, sets spend to 100% of benchmark, and shows the per-hospital derivation line. Existing 4 scenario presets relabelled '(illustrative)'. Also corrected the calculator's own model parameters to the CMS rules (were wrong): MSSP one-sided 50%->40% with 425.604(b) size-based MSR; ENHANCED cap 15->20%, loss rate flat 30% -> 1-0.75*quality bounded 40-75%, MSR/MLR 2%; ACO REACH Global invented 5% stop-loss -> 3.5% discount + PY2026 risk corridors; BPCI-Advanced (ended 12/31/2025) -> TEAM Track 3 (2% discount, 20% stop-gain/loss). Shares applyCorridors/msspOneSidedMsr with APMDesignLab.models.ts.
data_sources: CMS Medicare Geographic Variation PUF 2024, county level (data.cms.gov dataset 6219697b-8f6c-4164-bed4-cd9317c58ebc): BENES_OM_CNT, TOT_MDCR_PYMT_PC for the 14 VT counties
OneCare Vermont FY25 Budget Presentation to GMCB (11/13/2024): average Medicare attribution 51,354 -> 51.56% of 99,597 VT Original Medicare benes
GMCB FY2025 actuals (operating revenue shares used to split Windham and Windsor counties)
42 CFR 425.604-610; CMS ACO REACH PY2026 quick reference; CMS TEAM
note: No per-hospital attributed lives / benchmark PMPM is published for Vermont (OneCare reported statewide by payer and dissolved end-2025), so presets are a clearly-labelled DERIVED Medicare proxy: lives = county Original Medicare benes x 51.56%; PMPM = county 2024 actual Medicare per-capita / 12. County approximates HSA (Windham/Windsor split by GMCB FY25 revenue share; Essex->NVRH, Grand Isle->UVMMC); 14 rows allocate all 99,597 VT OM benes. Medicare-only; actual-spend performance not public so it is left at 100% for the reader. Range: $884 (North Country) to $1,035 (Porter) PMPM; 850 (Grace Cottage) to 10,550 (UVMMC) lives. tsc + eslint pass.
